package resp

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

var requiredFields = []string{"id"}

func assertFields(t *testing.T, body string, fields []string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, f := range fields {
		if !strings.Contains(body, "\""+f+"\"") {
			t.Errorf("missing field %s in %s", f, body)
		}
	}
}

func TestResponse(t *testing.T) {
	assertFields(t, Response(), requiredFields)
}

func otherHelper() int { return Unrelated() }

func TestOther(t *testing.T) {
	if otherHelper() != 2 {
		t.Fatal("unrelated")
	}
}
